seo.title: KIDS | Vetuonglai Kids — Learn the right way
seo.description: A learning layer for children in the Vetuonglai system. This public preview explains the learning structure, the guardian role, and a safe experience baseline.

hero.eyebrow: The Kids layer in the Vetuonglai system
hero.title: VETUONGLAI KIDS
hero.subline: A learning environment where children understand themselves, learn correctly, and create small verifiable outcomes.
hero.status_note: Public preview for children and guardians. Some experience layers are still being completed phase by phase.

audience.primary: Children who need a clear, safe, low-pressure environment for learning and making.
audience.guardian: Parents or guardians stay alongside the child, follow progress, and help when needed.

trust.what_it_is: A learn-and-make layer inside the Vetuonglai system. It does not replace school or exam preparation.
trust.what_it_is_not: It does not promise outcomes, create rankings, or use pressure-based language for children.
trust.status: This page is currently a public preview that explains the learning structure, sample outputs, and guardian role.

curriculum.summary: Children start from a short lesson, do one concrete task, submit a small output, receive feedback, and continue step by step.
